feature not built: team_invitations is only a row of team_id and email with no token, expiry, or acceptance flow (SECURITY.md defers acceptance).

The original 'notes: update own' policy has no membership check on team_id, so an owner can share into any team id; team members can update or delete any team note and insert notes with any user_id; there is no leave policy or unshare action.

teams select policy queries team_members while the team_members select policy queries teams, which is mutually recursive RLS; only add_team_owner sets search_path (that part is fine).

Team creation and invite-row insertion exist, but no invitation acceptance or email delivery means invitees can never join, and the recursive policies likely break team reads; no unshare or leave either.
